tha-ap173:1.1: Supāricariyavaggo sattarasamo. [171. Kumudamāliya.] Pabbate Himavantamhi mahājātassaro ahu / tatthajo rakkhaso āsiṃ ghorarūpo mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap173:2.1: *Kumudaṃ* pupphate tattha cakkamattāni jāyare / ocināmi c' ahaṃ pupphaṃ phalino samitaṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap173:3.1: Atthadassī tu bhagavā dipadindo narāsabho / pupphaṃ saṅkocitaṃ disvā āgacchi mama santikaṃ. // //
tha-ap173:4.1: Upāgatañ ca sambuddhaṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ / *sabbañ ca pupphaṃ paggayha* Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap173:5.1: Yāvatā Himavantato yāva samantato ahū / aggacchadanasampanno āgamāsi Tathāgato. // //
tha-ap173:6.1: Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap173:7.1: Ito pannarase kappe sattāhesuṃ *ja*nādhipā / Sahassaratha-nāmā te cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap173:9.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Kumudamāliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
